title: Correct the CLAUDE.md tag-move rule to name which tags are live for quest-web
description: Promised to quest-web in a cross-session exchange on 2026-09-30, during the 0.12.0 pair release (DEC-77/80): the CLAUDE.md profile in this repository tells a reader to clear any tag move with quest-web, but never says which tags are live. quest-web renders ${links.source}/releases/tag/v${release.version} from its own release.version (value in app/site-config.ts; rendered at app/page.tsx:273 and app/releases/page.tsx:121), so the tag at risk is the version quest-web currently cites -- v0.11.0, measured on their dev 2026-09-30 -- not the newest tag, and the set moves when their content next cites a new release. Deferred until the release settled; it has. Narrow correction: add the nouns to the tag-move rule, no rewrite.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The tags-are-load-bearing section move rule names the at-risk tag as the version quest-web currently cites, gives the measured value with its date (v0.11.0, 2026-09-30), cites where the citation renders, and says the set moves when quest-web content next cites a new release.
The change is confined to that rule: the existing measurements and history in that section are unchanged.
The required contexts (source-gates, Tracker integrity, lore check) report green on the PR head that lands it.

plan: Narrow edit: name the live tag (v0.11.0 as of 2026-09-30, the version quest-web cites via its release.version) and the tracking mechanism in the move-rule paragraph of the tags-are-load-bearing section.
PR to dev; required contexts green on the head; squash merge.
Tell quest-web the profile now names the live tag.
